The '''Warp Totem: Island''' is a [[Warp Totem]] that transports the player to [[Ginger Island]] by selecting it in inventory and {{key|right-clicking}}. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after purchasing the recipe from the [[Volcano Dungeon#Shop|Volcano Dwarf]] for {{Price|10000}}. One is obtained after repairing the [[Farm Obelisk]] on [[Ginger Island]].

==Bundles==
The Warp Totem: Island is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
The Warp Totem: Island can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Totem Mask|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
The Warp Totem: Island is not used in any [[quests]].
